title: The Grunion Run, xv
logline: Fifteenth year. The first Grunion Run he misses: it falls on a shift. He draws it at the desk from fourteen years of memory. The surf is at the desk.

panels.composition: The desk, 11 PM. WOOD drawing. BARNABY, thirteen, asleep under the desk — he's allowed now; nobody checks. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel night clerk drawing at the desk with an old dog asleep beneath it, razor-sharp ink, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: The pad: the beach, the lanterns, the surf line, the fish — drawn from memory, exact. Fourteen years' worth.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad showing a night beach with lanterns and a surf line full of silver fish, drawn precisely from memory

panels.composition: Wood looking at the glass door. Beyond it: the lot. Beyond the lot, not visible: the beach, twelve blocks, happening.

balloons.text: (to the dog) They're up by now.

image.prompt: a clerk looking through a motel's glass door at an empty lot at night, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel

panels.composition: Silent. The desk. The pad with the run on it. The dog. The door. The strip's fifteenth Grunion Run, indoors.

image.prompt: silent wide panel of a motel desk at night with a drawing of a beach festival on the pad, an old dog beneath, a glass door onto an empty lot, a flat unbroken line running beneath the panel, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The Grunion Run drawn from memory at the desk. The first one missed.
